style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for graphic and spec screens, warm cream #FAF6EA for info screens, bright sunlit photo scenes with sheer-curtain daylight; lemon-yellow #F7D33C used as frame bands, section dots, tags and highlight fills
style.iconSystem: thin-line outline icons in a single accent color, consistent lemon-yellow dot markers and rounded rectangular info labels
style.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight-style studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; sheer-curtain window daylight about 5500K for wear and scene shots, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh warm kids-apparel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm cream #FAF6EA, warm charcoal text #333333 and one lemon-yellow accent #F7D33C with a pale-yellow tint #FDF3C8 reserved for highlighted rows and cushions; bright soft daylight-style lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent centered section dividers with a small lemon-yellow dot and short Chinese labels; consistent thin-line outline icons in a single accent color; clean high-end childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable garment presentation and consistent product scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: generic child model with non-identifiable face for wear shots, stable slight 3/4 hero angle; flat-lay and macro for detail screens; consistent garment scale across the set; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-grey board #F0F0F0 for macro details, smooth warm white sweep and light wood floor in lifestyle scenes
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines, short Chinese headlines with letter-spaced caption bands, text in warm charcoal #333333
